payout_quote: Official Lugg mover-jobs page FAQ: 'Same day. You're paid every evening for that day's jobs and tips.' Example: box-truck driver, 25 hrs, $900 slot pay + $150 tips = $42.00/hr take-home rate.
timing: Same day — paid every evening for that day's jobs and tips.
eligibility: Helper role needs only a phone and ability to lift; no vehicle required

steps: Sign up on lugg.com/mover/jobs and complete onboarding
Pass background check and set up same-day payouts
Pick up slots in the Lugger app that fit your schedule

catches: Earnings vary a lot by market, effort, vehicle, and demand — the $42/hr is one box-truck example, not typical for helpers

Independent contractor: no benefits, self-employment taxes
biggest_catch: The eye-catching $42/hr figure is a box-truck driver example — helpers earn substantially less, and drivers eat gas and vehicle wear that the headline rate doesn't subtract.
upfront_fee: $0 (background check cost is deducted from future earnings).

repeatable.cadence: Pick up a slot each day, finish the move, and get paid that same evening — repeat daily as long as slots keep posting.

maximize: Start as a helper with zero vehicle investment and graduate to driver once you know the demand; grab slots early each morning when they post; chase weekend and end-of-month moves when customers tip more; keep your rating maxed so you see the best slots first; track mileage for the tax deduction since Lugg only partly reimburses it.
who_pays: Lugg pays you every evening for that day's jobs and tips. Tips come from customers, are split evenly on two-person jobs, and Lugg takes no cut of them.
who_qualifies: You must be 18 or older. Helpers need just a phone and the ability to lift — no vehicle required. Drivers need a 2001-or-newer vehicle in good cosmetic condition. Everyone passes a background check (its cost comes out of future earnings, nothing upfront) and connects a debit card or bank account for same-day payouts.
work_available: Slots post in the Lugger app and the good ones go to early birds — expect competition, and demand varies a lot by market, season, and whether you're a helper or a driver.
what_gets_accepted: You get paid that same evening for each completed slot; keeping your rating maxed is what gets you shown the best slots first. Lugg's specific non-payment triggers and removal policy are not publicly stated.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No upfront fee — the background check is deducted from future earnings. If you drive, you cover gas, tolls, and vehicle wear (Lugg only partly reimburses mileage). Unpaid time: onboarding, competing for slots each morning, and driving to job sites.
when_cash_arrives: Same day — Lugg pays you every evening for that day's jobs and tips, straight to your connected debit card or bank account.
